content.title: Safeway at Hechinger Mall Closing Update and Future Plans for the Site - PoPville
content.text: 1601 Maryland Ave, NE Thanks to ANC Commissioner Charquinta McCray for sending us an update on the closing plans for the Safeway at Hechinger Mall: “what we know so far: •The pharmacy will close on April 1, with prescriptions being transferred to the Safeway on Capitol Hill (1415 14th Street SE). •The store will officially close on May 16, though some staff may remain temporarily to support closure operations. •The H Street/Hechinger Mall ownership group is actively seeking a replacement grocer, but no confirmed progress has been made yet. •For the foreseeable future, Aldi will be the only grocery store in the immediate area, which we all recognize is not sufficient to meet the community’s needs.” STAY TUNED. #closing Featured Event Go to “Green” Trivia Night “Green” Trivia Night April 2, 2026 7:00 pm -9:00 pm Trivia night is in partnership with Zero Waste in DC! Trivia will run from 7-9pm and include general trivia genres as well as a special sponsored round of Sustainability and “green” trivia questions!
